# olivares_rbac_grant (Resource)

An RBAC grant in the Olivares AI governance control plane (module I): an immutable binding of a subject to a role, optionally scoped to a resource boundary. Changing any attribute forces replacement. Authoring requires governance:rbac:admin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A grant with no scope is global. Adding scope/scope_ref confines the role to one
# workspace, which is how a viewer is kept from reading every workspace at once.
resource "olivares_rbac_grant" "alice_admin" {
  subject_type = "user"
  subject_ref  = "alice@example.com"
  role         = "admin"
}

resource "olivares_rbac_grant" "team_viewer" {
  subject_type = "group"
  subject_ref  = "engineering"
  role         = "viewer"
  scope        = "workspace"
  scope_ref    = "ws-prod"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role` (String) Role to grant (e.g. admin, viewer, editor). Immutable (changing it replaces the resource).
- `subject_ref` (String) Subject reference (e.g. user email, group id, service account id). Immutable (changing it replaces the resource).
- `subject_type` (String) Subject type: user, group or service_account. Immutable (changing it replaces the resource).

### Optional

- `scope` (String) Optional scope type for the grant (e.g. project, workspace). Immutable (changing it replaces the resource).
- `scope_ref` (String) Optional scope reference narrowing the grant to a specific resource (e.g. project id). Immutable (changing it replaces the resource).
- `tenant` (String) Tenant UUID for this resource, overriding the provider-level tenant. Sent as X-Olivares-Tenant.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Server-assigned creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Server-assigned grant ID.
